record.title: HAIDI HDCF18650-1800 | LFP | lithiation | 0.05C | Rehm2025

temperature.description: Original Rehm2025 paper Section 1 states half-cell measurements at 25 C; full-cell temperatures are stored separately.

x.definition: Normalized branch progress, not absolute lithium fraction or full-cell SOC. The author notice reports swapped anode direction/capacity conventions; named electrode direction and source endpoint potentials define this curation axis. Original source capacity/row are retained.
x.domain_basis: Retained native nodes only; no extrapolation, resampling or endpoint insertion.

cell_link.evidence: Original paper identifies HAIDI HDCF18650-1800 (LIBHE); author notice links these electrode branches to that paper. Same-study full-cell tests are externally linked; exact harvested donor and test serials unresolved.

processing.coordinate_transform: q01=(q-min(q))/(max(q)-min(q)); x=1-q01 if reverse_normalized_axis else q01; stable sort ascending x
processing.orientation_basis: Author notice names electrode lithiation/delithiation. Endpoint potential decreases on lithiation and increases on delithiation. Original capacity and row retained; no chronological acquisition order inferred.
processing.filtering: No additional smoothing, clipping, resampling, deleted nodes or inserted endpoints. The original paper reports filtered displayed curves; exact MAT filtering history is unresolved.

limitations: Author-processed finite-current pseudo-OCP, not certified equilibrium or an original instrument recording.
Absolute half-cell Ah, lithium stoichiometry, exact cycle selection and MAT filtering history are not supplied.
Mirror-to-original-dataset byte identity cannot be checked while provider file inventory is unavailable.
Supplied voltage coverage may be narrower than the complete protocol; no missing cutoff endpoints are inserted.
Millivolt-scale cutoff excursions remain unchanged; source voltages are not clipped.
Same-study association does not establish identical serialized half-cell/full-cell specimens or a transferable complete D/kinetics set.
No independent electrochemical-model validation is claimed.

haidi-rehm2025-data.title: Rehm2025 HAIDI LFP/graphite subset of rate, OCV, impedance and half-cell dataset
haidi-rehm2025-data.version: Dataset published 2025-01-31; author branch mirror from fixed release 19555109
haidi-rehm2025-data.license_evidence: Exact-DOI TUM publisher metadata in open.bydata/GovData identifies cc-by with author attribution; GovData and the official DCAT vocabulary map it to CC BY 4.0. Empty/incomplete duplicate metadata are retained in the review. Framework MIT is not the data grant.
haidi-rehm2025-data.role: Seven native author-processed half-cell branches, one quarantined original; same-study full-cell tests remain external. Original provider file inventory and mirror/raw-file identity unresolved.

rehm-2025.title: Comparing the electrical performance of commercial sodium-ion and lithium-iron-phosphate batteries
rehm-2025.role: Model identity, half-cell Li/25 C/rate definitions and full-cell multi-temperature charge/discharge/GEIS protocols. Only LIBHE selected; sodium-ion cell types excluded.

rehm-2026.title: How to determine the degradation modes of lithium-ion batteries with silicon-graphite blend electrodes
rehm-2026.role: Methods Section 2.4 establishes lithium-counter coin-cell measurements; Data availability points to author GitHub. Article license is not used to relicense external tables.

experiment.configuration: Harvested single-side-coated HAIDI electrode, 14 mm disk, CR2032 half-cell against metallic lithium; 80 uL LP57
experiment.protocol: 0.02C main protocol with earlier 0.05C cycles and 1 h pauses; graphite 0.01-1.5 V, LFP 2-4 V vs Li. Exact supplied MAT cycle indices unresolved.
known_issues: One 0.05C cathode branch quarantined separately; original retained

export.note: Formula samples are calculated, not measurements. Read the record's coordinate, direction, conditions and license.
